purpose: Promotional Free Flight game cover, distinct from Runway Glide. Gameplay remains live 3D geometry.
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: square premium game cover for a browser flight game named Free Flight, displayed beside a separate airliner-landing game. Create a cinematic photorealistic aviation scene, no text. A single orange-and-white high-wing bush airplane with fixed landing gear and one nose propeller flies freely over a sweeping turquoise coastline, forested headlands, white surf only at the shore, distant craggy mountains and sunlit clouds. View from another aircraft at a front three-quarter angle, airplane fills about 65% of the frame and is the sharp focal point, the whole wingspan fits inside the square. The airplane has realistic wing struts, clean cockpit glazing, three wheels and a motion-blurred propeller; no airline branding. Bright late-afternoon daylight, natural metallic surfaces, sense of freedom and a vast landscape to explore. Strong readable thumbnail composition, polished realistic flight-simulator cover style. No runway as the main subject, no airliner, no UI, no lettering, no borders, no watermark. Square 1:1 composition.
